name: Kadrak
summary: At the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak guards the northern road into Ashenvale. He sends reports and reinforcements toward the fighting between the Horde and the night elves.

sections.title: Guardian of the Rampart
sections.body: Kadrak watches over the main road from the Barrens into Ashenvale. The Mor'shan Rampart marks a hard border, with Horde-held plains to the south and woods guarded by night elves to the north. Sentinels and hostile woodland creatures threaten the line, so Kadrak keeps watch against incursions.

sections.title: Frontline Logistics
sections.body: Kadrak receives military reports from the Barrens and the logging camps deeper in Ashenvale. Couriers bring news from the Warsong Outriders, and he directs supplies and reinforcements to outposts such as Splintertree Post. Those who report to him are sent onward into the struggle for the forest.

aliases: who is the orc at the wall
faq.answer: Kadrak is an orc officer at the Mor'shan Rampart. He watches the border and directs Horde forces traveling between the Barrens and the fighting in Ashenvale.
Kadrak is at the Mor'shan Rampart, a fortified wooden barricade at the Barrens' northern edge, where the road leads into Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is Kadrak's role in the Horde?
faq.answer: Kadrak commands the border defenses and gathers military reports from scout runners. He briefs Horde travelers heading north to reinforce outposts such as Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why is the Mor'shan Rampart heavily defended?
faq.answer: The Mor'shan Rampart guards the northern approaches to the Barrens and Durotar from night elf incursions, which answer the Horde's logging operations in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What quests does Kadrak provide or complete?
faq.answer: Kadrak receives reports from the Barrens and sends adventurers on assignments involving Warsong scouting reports and strengthening the Horde presence along the forest frontier.

faq.q: Does Kadrak have ties to other notable Horde figures?
faq.answer: Kadrak stays in regular contact with the Warsong Outriders in Ashenvale. He receives their scouting reports at the Rampart.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can look to Kadrak to send warriors north to defend lumber operations and claim Horde territory in Ashenvale.
If you fight for the Alliance and try to enter the Barrens from Ashenvale, Kadrak's rampart blocks the road into the Horde heartland.
As an orc, you can see Kadrak's defense of the Ashenvale border as part of the Warsong Clan's effort to claim territory.
As a warrior, you know the discipline it takes to hold a fortified choke point against woodland fighters and guerrilla raids.
